# Code of Conduct

[繁體中文](/.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) | **English** | [日本語](/.github/i18n/CODE_OF_CONDUCT_ja.md) | [ไทย](/.github/i18n/CODE_OF_CONDUCT_th.md) | [Bahasa Indonesia](/.github/i18n/CODE_OF_CONDUCT_id.md) | [한국어](/.github/i18n/CODE_OF_CONDUCT_ko.md)

This project adopts the [Contributor Covenant 3.0](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/3/0/code_of_conduct/) as its code of conduct. The sections below add this project's scope, the things it cares about most, how to report a problem and how reports are handled.

## Scope

This repo's issues, pull requests, Discussions, commit and code review comments, and any public setting where someone takes part on behalf of this project.

## What this project cares about most

- When discussing LINE specs, base your points on the official docs or test results, and address the content, not the person.
- 繁體中文, English, 日本語, ไทย, Bahasa Indonesia and 한국어 are all welcome. When something is unclear or you've been misunderstood, be patient and try asking again in other words; don't look down on anyone for their language skills, experience or the AI tool they use.
- Don't post anyone's channel access token, channel secret, LINE userId, groupId or other private information, including your own. If something is posted by mistake, the maintainer will hide or delete it.
- Don't impersonate others, LY Corporation or official LINE.
- Harassment, personal attacks, discriminatory remarks and publishing others' information without consent are never acceptable.

## How to report

- **When it needs to stay confidential, or involves harassment**: email [yao921024@gmail.com](mailto:yao921024@gmail.com); only the maintainer sees it. Please include when it happened and any related links or screenshots.
- **When it can be public**: mention @Scorpio-meow in the related issue, PR or Discussion, or open an issue describing it.
- **To let GitHub handle it**: if the person reported is the maintainer, or you'd prefer a third party to handle it, choose **Report content** from the "⋯" menu at the top right of the comment, or **Block or Report** on the person's profile page; the report goes to GitHub Support. See the [GitHub docs](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/maintaining-your-safety-on-github/reporting-abuse-or-spam) for the steps.
- **Security vulnerabilities**: don't disclose details publicly; report privately as described in the [security policy](/.github/SECURITY_en.md).

## How reports are handled

The maintainer follows the Contributor Covenant 3.0 process, keeps the reporter's identity and the details of the report confidential, and tells the reporter the outcome. Depending on the case, the maintainer may remind the people involved, hide or delete content, lock conversations, limit interactions, or temporarily or permanently block accounts. The goal is to repair harm so everyone can keep working together, not just to punish.
